data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue
data.body:
Hi,

I’m Andrew, founder of Local Ledger, an independent research publisher using public records only and never issuer-paid.

Heartland Advisors’ most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in INBK, PINE, and PCYO.

On August 25, 2026, PCYO disclosed a director or officer change in an 8-K Item 5.02 filing (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/276720/000110465926100607/pcyo-20260824x8k.htm).

May I send the free weekly issue and set up a four-week fund pilot?

Reply "no" and I won't follow up.

Andrew
Founder, Local Ledger
